page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfc6.20xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal compute-oriented server running on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 80 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors with a base frequency of 3.1 GHz. The platform is provisioned with 192.0 GB of memory, yielding 2.4 GB per vCPU core. It operates via the KVM hypervisor while delivering bare-metal physical compute access without hypervisor performance penalties.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 32 Gbps. The instance provides no integrated local disk storage and zero discrete GPUs, relying exclusively on network-attached block volumes for system and data storage. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are attached by default.

With a high core count, elevated 3.1 GHz clock speed, and a lean memory ratio, the configuration is structured around CPU-dense processing. This server profile is suited for compute-bound engineering workloads, multi-threaded software compilation, high-traffic web serving tiers, and batch processing clusters that prioritize clock speed over high memory capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfc6.20xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal compute-optimized instance equipped with 80 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at 3.1 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server features 192.0 GB of system RAM, providing 2.4 GB of memory per core, and is backed by a 32 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance contains no local storage and does not include hardware GPUs, requiring external network-attached storage for operating systems and persistent data. Without virtualization overhead and with high CPU clock frequencies, this configuration is suited for compute-heavy parallel workloads, large-scale CI/CD build environments, batch computational jobs, and distributed backend web application serving.
